facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog advises that awareness campaigns should run about 12 months before the enrollment deadline, when prospective students are in a discovery mindset.
facts.quote: Running awareness campaigns 12 months in advance will get your institution and programs on the radar of prospective students.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says prospective students move into the consideration stage about 9 months before the enrollment deadline.
facts.quote: About 9 months out from your enrollment deadline, students are moving into the consideration stage.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog recommends starting retargeting and encouraging applications at about 6 months before the institution's enrollment deadline.
facts.quote: At about 6 months from your institution’s enrollment deadline, it’s time to encourage students to apply to your programs.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog recommends personalizing campaigns in the 3 months before the enrollment deadline, when prospective students are in decision mode.
facts.quote: In the 3 months ahead of your enrollment deadline, it’s time to personalize your campaigns.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog states that college marketers should start their marketing efforts a calendar year in advance of enrollment targets.
facts.quote: be prepared to start your college marketing efforts a calendar year in advance.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog describes four key mindset stages of prospective students that digital efforts should target.
facts.quote: There are four key mindset stages in prospective students that you’ll want to cater your digital efforts towards.
